notes.title: Anniversary and Pilfer: Story of Light!
notes.content:
Crow Story is nearing it's 2 year anniversary! I'm amazing at how many people have played this little game, with almost 300 reviews at the time of writing. While Crow Story is just a cute cozy little platformer, it sparked my journey as a indie dev. I just want to let you know how happy I am to hear that my games bring some joy to players :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2153020/Pilfer_Story_of_Light/

Pilfer released earlier this year as well, if you enjoyed Crow Story, then you'll love Pilfer! And as always, I'm always working on something new in the background (╹◡◠)

If you want to be up to date on what I'm doing, check out my [url=https://twitter.com/log64dev]Twitter [/url]or [url=https://t.co/QBV6IOxBMT]Discord Server[/url]!

notes.title: Pilfer: Story of Light is now available!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2153020/Pilfer_Story_of_Light/

After about 1 1/2 years of work, Pilfer: Story of Light is now available! I hope you all enjoy this new 3D platforming journey featuring Pilfer and Lumi <3

Thanks to everyone who's supported me - from my loving girlfriend, my dev discord server, the Crow Story speed running discord server, and everyone who decided to play my little game Crow Story 2 years ago. I couldn't have done it without you all :)

notes.title: Wishlist Pilfer: Story of Light!
notes.content:
A new journey awaits in Pilfer: Story of Light!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2153020/Pilfer_Story_of_Light/

Pilfer: Story of Light is the 3D platformer follow-up to Crow Story. It features over 30 course-based levels and 80+ unique level mechanics. Meet other animals along the quest to restore the Light to the forest, unlock costumes and challenge levels, and maybe even see some familiar faces along the way. I'm excited for Pilfer to drop on August 4th!

Wishlist it today!

notes.title: Crow Story V1.1.1 hotfix
notes.content:
Hotfix 1.1.1 is now live!

[list]
[*] Wall jumps now chain.
[*] The camera now orients to match Kuroh whenever you respawn.
[*] Kuroh now tweets whenever he respawns.
[*] General camera improvements.
[*] Added a button in the Skins menu to reset your save.
[*] Fixed a bug where the timer would not reset upon continuing, starting a new game, or closing the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where your last checkpoint would not update upon continuing, starting a new game, or closing the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Max FPS graphics option would not work for certain options.
[*] Fixed a bug where your timer and death counter would reset upon closing the game.
[*] Fixed a bug with one of the checkpoints in Level 2.
[/list]
